mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_at, s.store_name, AS display_status, o.app_at, MAX(od.store_at) AS store_at, o.total_price, u.user_name FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id LEFT JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, s.store_name, o.app_at, o.total_price, u.user_name

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY od.order_detail_id) AS row_no, od.order_detail_id, i.ingredient_name, od.order_quantity, i.order_unit, od.supply_price, od.order_price, od.order_status, od.reject_reason FROM orders o JOIN order_details od On o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY od.order_detail_id
mapper.update: UPDATE orders o JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id SET od.order_status = #{status}, od.reject_reason = #{reason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, od.app_at = NOW(), od.manufacture_at = COALESCE(#{manufactureAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, od.manufacture_at), o.app_at = NOW() WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND od.order_detail_id = #{detailId} AND od.order_status = '대기' AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND #{status} IN ('승인', '거절')
